Search for bestdigitools.com. Here is exactly what opens, and what is inside.
A review site built around one question: which digital tool is actually right for your business?
Eight categories, from web hosting and VPNs to AI tools and e-commerce.
There's a free resources section too, with WordPress themes, free to download.
But the heart of the site is head to head. Two tools, one winner, decided in minutes.
Take Shopify versus Squarespace. Both expert scores sit side by side. No burying the weaker one.
Round one is pricing. Entry price against real-world cost.
Then it's broken into rounds. Setup, design, e-commerce depth, support, each one scored separately.
Round three breaks down the features, line by line. Exactly what your money buys.
What we loved, and where it falls short. Every tool gets both columns.
Every comparison ends the same way: a clear winner, and exactly who it's for.
